name: Retailer Service 2 Code
definition: List of specific services for ServiceRequest

FSPQ.name: Financial Payment Request
FSPQ.definition: The Sale System requests to the POI System to perform a payment(Purchase/Refund/PWCB/MOTO Payment/...).

FSRQ.name: Financial Reversal Request
FSRQ.definition: The Sale System requests to the POI System to perform a reversal partial or complete to cancel a former payment service.

FSIQ.name: Financial Balance Inquiry Request
FSIQ.definition: The Sale System requests to the POI System to perform balance inquiry on the main account.

FSBQ.name: Financial Batch Request
FSBQ.definition: The Batch message pair is used to request or get the result of transactions (payment, loyalty and reversal) performed without connection to the Sale system (Payment delivery).

FSLQ.name: Financial Loyalty Request
FSLQ.definition: The Sale System requests to the POI System a loyalty service like loading or redeem.

FSVQ.name: Financial Stored Value Request
FSVQ.definition: The Sale System requests to the POI System to manage a stored value card or account (eg. Load, Payment, Reimbursement).

FSEQ.name: Financial Enable Service Request
FSEQ.definition: The Sale System requests to the POI System to enable a service on its side.

FSAQ.name: Financial Card Acquisition Request
FSAQ.definition: The Sale System requests to the POI System to handle a card data acquisition on the card reader.

FSCQ.name: Financial Reconciliation Request
FSCQ.definition: The Sale System request to the POI System different kinds of transaction reconciliation.
